what_worked.description: Structured JSON output format (editorial headline, product specs, Amazon bullet points, Shopify description, prompt descriptors) integrates seamlessly into CMS/e-commerce without manual parsing
Using sensory luxury adjectives ('whisper-soft faux georgette', 'radiant antique gold zari') boosts conversion scores

what_failed.failure_mode: Overly generic e-commerce clichés ('must-have addition to your wardrobe')
what_failed.root_cause: Unconstrained temperature causing standard LLM conversational filler

what_to_adapt.rule_addition: Strictly prohibit generic filler clichés; insist on artisanal couture terminology and heritage craftsmanship descriptors
